capabilities.capability_name: ReuseFirst proportional reuse and shareability gate
capabilities.original_internal_purpose: Require evidence-backed reuse discovery and proportional shareability review before new factory machinery.
capabilities.recurrence: Multiple factory and product consumers; Customer Zero dogfood verified.
capabilities.problem_solved: Speculative duplicate machinery and weak artifact provenance.
capabilities.maturity: PUBLIC_RELEASED with verified Customer Zero dogfood
capabilities.differentiation_hypothesis: Portable evidence-first reuse decisions may help small software factories avoid duplicate work.
capabilities.standalone_usefulness: Plausible but external workflow is unobserved.
capabilities.composability: Can run as a deterministic local decision contract.
capabilities.telemetry_learning_potential: Low without collecting sensitive factory decision context; prefer explicit records.
capabilities.security_privacy_implications: Local metadata only; external records could disclose private architecture.
capabilities.confidence: MEDIUM for internal usefulness; LOW for external market value
unresolved_questions: Do independent factories experience this workflow?
capabilities.recommended_next_evidence_action: Observe one independent factory workflow before changing the released surface.

externalization.risk_review: Review private decision metadata before any external observation.
externalization.learning_objective: Determine whether the reuse problem exists outside Foculoom.
externalization.authorization_required: Human authorization is required for outreach or interview.

capabilities.capability_name: Rendit deterministic rendering and provenance workflow
capabilities.original_internal_purpose: Produce deterministic visual assets with validation, provenance, and review controls.
capabilities.recurrence: Multiple Foculoom consumers and a clean deterministic probe.
capabilities.problem_solved: Coupled rendering workflows make reproducibility, provenance, and review difficult.
capabilities.maturity: Internal prototype with deterministic probe complete
capabilities.differentiation_hypothesis: A narrow visual recipe plus provenance contract may solve a workflow not covered by generic build provenance tools.
capabilities.standalone_usefulness: Plausible for a defined asset workflow; not independently validated.
capabilities.composability: Potential workflow-level boundary over one canonical runtime.
capabilities.telemetry_learning_potential: High product-learning value from explicit workflow/job observations; invasive telemetry is not justified.
capabilities.security_privacy_implications: Asset, font, binary, dependency licensing and private source paths require review.
capabilities.confidence: HIGH for internal feasibility; LOW for external demand
unresolved_questions: Can licensing and dependency boundaries be made safe?
capabilities.recommended_next_evidence_action: Run one human-authorized external workflow observation or interview with a defined substitute; do not package yet.

externalization.risk_review: No publication, code exposure, dependency installation, or private asset transfer; review consent and licensing boundaries.
externalization.learning_objective: Identify the external job, substitute, frequency, friction, and measurable value before packaging.
externalization.authorization_required: Human authorization is required for observation, interview, or outreach.

capabilities.original_internal_purpose: Make provenance, safety, shareability, and evidence failures machine-detectable.
capabilities.recurrence: Two factory validation consumers are recorded.
capabilities.differentiation_hypothesis: Factory-specific provenance and safety contracts may be useful to similar governed factories.
capabilities.telemetry_learning_potential: Low; validation outcomes are sufficient for current learning.
capabilities.security_privacy_implications: Exposes factory policy and privileged evidence boundaries.
unresolved_questions: Can policy be generalized without strategic leakage?
capabilities.recommended_next_evidence_action: Keep internal and revisit only if an independent governed workflow appears.

externalization.risk_review: Strategic policy and trust-boundary leakage outweigh unproven learning value.
externalization.authorization_required: Human review would be required for any generalized surface.

capabilities.capability_name: Rung repository governance evidence and replay receipts
capabilities.original_internal_purpose: Assess observable repository governance evidence and bind repeatable audit results to exact source revisions.
capabilities.recurrence: One public engine and one separate local report-service consumer are evidenced; compatibility across pinned revisions remains unverified.
capabilities.problem_solved: Unstructured repository governance claims and unverifiable audit-result provenance.
capabilities.maturity: Validated local candidate; not an sf0.8 shared artifact
capabilities.differentiation_hypothesis: A bounded evidence-state and replay contract may make agent-authority decisions more auditable than policy text alone.
capabilities.standalone_usefulness: Plausible; current local evidence does not establish demand or compatibility with sf0.8 workflows.
capabilities.composability: CLI and serialized-result boundary are plausible; report-service compatibility needs a versioned contract test.
capabilities.telemetry_learning_potential: Low; explicit receipts and replay observations are preferable to telemetry.
capabilities.security_privacy_implications: Audits may disclose repository governance posture; receipt inputs and report data require local handling.
capabilities.confidence: HIGH for local capability; LOW for sf0.8 shared-artifact fit and external value
unresolved_questions: Does the current Rung revision remain compatible with rungreport's pinned engine contract?
Is there an owner-approved sf0.8 consumer?
What exact receipt data may be shared safely?
capabilities.recommended_next_evidence_action: Run a versioned compatibility fixture between the current Rung engine and the pinned report-service contract only after owner-approved intake.

externalization.risk_review: No dependency installation, publication, or report-data transfer is authorized by this inventory record.
externalization.authorization_required: Human authorization is required for shared intake, compatibility work, or publication.

capabilities.capability_name: FLocal contract-bound patch application and sandboxed verification
capabilities.original_internal_purpose: Keep model-authored patches separate from authority, path policy, command execution, acceptance, and evidence.
capabilities.recurrence: One local factory implementation is evidenced; its bundled benchmark contract is not an independent consumer.
capabilities.problem_solved: Unsafe model-authored changes and verification commands crossing workspace or credential boundaries.
capabilities.maturity: Validated local candidate; not an sf0.8 shared artifact
capabilities.differentiation_hypothesis: A local-first contract and rollback boundary may improve safety for constrained model-generated changes without granting commit or publication authority.
capabilities.standalone_usefulness: Plausible; no independent consumer or immutable source revision is currently evidenced.
capabilities.composability: Contract, patch, runner, and sandbox boundaries are separable but platform-specific.
capabilities.telemetry_learning_potential: Low; bounded run evidence is sufficient and generated-code data should remain local.
capabilities.security_privacy_implications: Sandbox and path-policy failures could expose credentials, factory source, or host files; platform assumptions must fail closed.
capabilities.confidence: HIGH for local trust-boundary design; LOW for shared-artifact fit
unresolved_questions: What immutable source repository and revision should be accepted?
Can the Seatbelt boundary be contract-tested outside the originating project?
Is there a second independently useful consumer?
capabilities.recommended_next_evidence_action: Obtain an owner-approved immutable source revision and define a clean-room second-consumer contract before any extraction.

externalization.risk_review: Trust-boundary implementation and absent immutable provenance make extraction unsafe without owner review.
externalization.authorization_required: Human authorization is required for source intake, sandbox review, or publication.
